printf '%s\n' '--- drop-ins ---'
find /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
for f in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; printf 'FILE %s\n' "$f"; grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*(PasswordAuthentication|KbdInteractiveAuthentication|PubkeyAuthentication|AuthenticationMethods|Match)[[:space:]]' "$f" || true; done

set -eu

chmod 0644 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/01-key-only.conf
